navNotes: Settings is not an entry in src/modules/nav.ts; the App layout adds "Einstellungen" as a plain sidebar link (group "Organisation", → /settings/profile), and the user menu "Konto" also opens /settings/profile. The sections are a <SectionNav> beside the page (src/app/(app)/settings/tabs.ts, layout.tsx), not sidebar sub-pages. redesign.research: Linear (Account: Profile · Preferences · Notifications · Security & access · Connected accounts / Workspace: General · Members · …), Vercel (personal Account vs Team settings, one left nav with two groups), Stripe (Personal details vs Business settings), GitHub (personal settings vs organization settings). All: one left nav grouped by 'you' and 'the workspace', each page a stack of grouped rows, switches save at once, text values inline or in a small dialog, destructive things ask. On phones (Linear / GitHub mobile): the settings index is a list of rows with ›, a row opens the page, back returns to the list.
redesign.decision: Section nav grouped 'Du' (Profil · Benachrichtigungen · Sicherheit · KI-Assistent) / 'Organisation' (Allgemein · Team · Rollen · Module · Bereiche · Felder · Orte · Integrationen · API), each org item only with the permission that changes it (Allgemein/Module/Felder/Orte org.settings.manage, Team/Rollen org.members.manage, Integrationen/API org.integrations.manage; Bereiche when at least one area settings page is open to the person). Phones: /settings is the index (grouped rows with ›), sub-pages have a back chevron to it; desktop: /settings opens Profil. Sidebar 'Einstellungen' → /settings; user menu 'Konto' → Profil. Area settings stay behind each area's gear (listed in Bereiche); platform admin stays /admin.
